overview.title: Explore your city's environment
overview.subtitle: See what matters for cycling: air, road surface, traffic, shade and lighting. Turn layers on and off and click an area for details.
overview.streetLayersHint: Layers that colour the streets are shown one at a time.
overview.detailsEmpty: Click an area on the map to see its measured indicators, data source and unit.
overview.areaNote: Area = 500 m × 500 m grid cell. Values are averages of the measurements inside it.
overview.indexNote: Risk indices are calculated by ATRAI from senseBox:bike sensor rides (0 = low, 1 = high). They are not concentrations in µg/m³.

planTrip.title: Find your greenest route
planTrip.subtitle: Compare the shortest route with a route planned around what you care about: smooth streets, safe overtaking, clean air and fewer stops.
planTrip.clickHint: Click the map to set the start, then the destination.
planTrip.preferTimeHint: Plans by riding time, using the speeds cyclists were measured at.
planTrip.departTimeHint: Needed for the shade and lighting sliders: shade counts by day, lighting after dark.

routes.shortestHint: The most direct path, ignoring comfort.

planTrip.sameAsShortest: Your route is the same as the shortest route.
planTrip.difference: Compared with the shortest route: distance {{distance}}, riding time {{time}}.
planTrip.appliedShade: Departure by day: shaded streets were preferred.
planTrip.appliedDark: Departure after dark: lit streets were preferred.
planTrip.emptyState: Set a start and destination to compare routes. Values only appear when they come from real data.
